# Ashutosh Mishra

> Senior Data Scientist and AI lead at S&P Global, building generative AI and machine learning systems used in production. Writes about LLMs, adapters and hypernetworks, on-device AI, scientific ML, and model benchmarking.

This site is the portfolio and blog of Ashutosh Mishra. The home page covers his experience, technical practice and achievements; the blog holds project write-ups with results, figures and stated limitations.
